title: Legislative Branch: USC Undergraduate Student Government
text:
Legislative Branch: USC Undergraduate Student Government

Purpose: The page describes the branch as the center of advocacy. It aims to build an inclusive, collaborative space for finding solutions to student problems, often with other organizations and administrative offices.

Composition: Vice President, Chief Diversity Officer, and Speaker of the Senate; 12 senators; 6 Standing Committees; Advocacy liaisons; support staff (Parliamentary Secretary, Legislative Aides, and Senate Aides).

Senate meetings: 'Come to a Senate meeting! We meet every Tuesday at 7pm in TCC 450.' Attendees can also join on Zoom. Agendas and minutes are posted in a shared Drive folder.

Standing committees (six): Academic Affairs; Accessibility; Affordability & Basic Needs; External Affairs; Sustainability & Campus Infrastructures; Wellness Affairs. The page does not list committee meeting times or locations; check the USG calendar.

Projects: The page reports 52 active projects, $19,000 in total budget allocated, and 49,323 students impacted. A second widget on the same page shows 34 active projects and $10,000 allocated, with the same student count; the figures conflict. A project tracker shows a Project Status Distribution and Projects by Committee view, and lists the next deadline as Dec 1.

Documents and resources: Constitution and Bylaws; Office Hours & Staff Roster; Brand Guidelines; Calendar.

Contact: Office: 3607 Trousdale Pkwy, SKS 404, Los Angeles, CA 90089. General email: usg@usc.edu.

Not covered on this page: open forum rules; the bill process (a Senate Bills section is listed with no content); individual senator contact details (the Office Hours & Staff Roster may help).
